metas.name: Ted Lasso
metas.description: Ted Lasso, an American football coach, moves to England when he's hired to manage a soccer team—despite having no experience. With cynical players and a doubtful town, will he get them to see the Ted Lasso Way?

metas.name: Club de Cuervos
metas.description: When the patriarch of a prominent family dies, his heirs battle to determine who will gain control of his beloved soccer team: The Cuervos of Nuevo Toledo.

metas.name: District League
metas.description: A comedy series set in the world of a rural football team, which follows one season of the SK Houslice football club.

metas.name: Mike Bassett: Manager
metas.description: After England’s attempt at qualifying for the 2004 European Championships ends in disaster, Mike is offered the manager's job at the seemingly doomed Wirral County F.C.
